title: Screen: when drying ends, the drying page's Start button is enabled again, and a screen that shows drying returns to the home page
note: The drying settings page keeps a pointer to its Start button (saved in a free slot of .q2_queue_state when the page is drawn). When the drying state changes to 'not drying', the Start button is re-evaluated with QIDI's own rule (disabled only while the printer is busy), and if the screen is on a drying page it switches to Page_Home (queued on the GUI queue), as it does after Stop on the screen. Code: 35 instructions in the free part of .q2_queue_text.
